text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the spring Tenno Sho, one of Gold Ship's big landmark races for the year, and she is acting as strange as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oh-hohoho! Refined laughter echoes throughout the paddock. By learning the ways of etiquette, Gold Ship has transformed into the noblest of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Eishin Flash blocks her path. For the sake of victory and a clue, Gold Ship must elegantly dance―nay, race her way to the goal!
